Traffic Rider: Neon Rush

About Traffic Rider: Neon Rush

Traffic Rider: Neon Rush is an exciting 3D motorcycle racing game where you ride a powerful sports bike through busy city highways filled with cars, trucks, and challenging traffic. Experience high-speed riding, dodge vehicles, avoid crashes, and test your riding skills on thrilling roads. Stay focused, master your bike controls, and enjoy the ultimate traffic racing adventure!

How to play

W Up Arrow Accelerate S Down Arrow Brake or Reverse A Left Arrow Steer Left D Right Arrow Steer Right Use WASD or Keyboard Arrow Keys to control your motorcycle
